mentions.name: Orpheus
mentions.description: Orpheus is a browser-based tabletop RPG simulator that generates campaigns fully on the fly, blending a Telltale-style narrative game, a visual novel, and a TTRPG. An AI GM keeps the game coherent while generating graphics and TTS audio as needed, supporting sci-fi, fantasy, or modern settings. It includes a 3D tabletop for combat, full character sheets, dice rolling, and lore tracking, and is playable with either a keyboard or gamepad. The author is running a playtest waitlist and Discord, with asset generation cost as the current roadblock.
mentions.problem: Text-based generated TTRPGs were hard to connect with stylistically; the author needed multimodal stimulus of visuals and audio, so built a generated tabletop simulator instead. Current roadblock: asset generation is relatively expensive.
mentions.audience: Tabletop RPG players who want an on-the-fly generated campaign with visuals and audio, playable in the browser with keyboard or gamepad from the couch.
mentions.source_excerpt: Orpheus (https://orpheus.gg) is a fully on-the-fly generated tabletop simulator, with graphics, audio (TTS), and the freedom you can usually only find at a real TTRPG table. That means you can play a sci-fi, fantasy, or even a modern setting in your campaign.
